goal: Make the node disconnect peers that send oversized getblocks/getheaders locators instead of leaving them connected
Fixes a gap where a malformed locator count triggered a generic deserialization error rather than proper enforcement
reviewability: Ready for review, the one substantive gap found was fixed and pushed, remaining design discussion was resolved by explanation
agreement: Verified by testing that oversized locator counts bypassed disconnection, later confirmed fixed (jeanpablojp)
Design alternative of reusing HEADERS-style local parsing raised (mzumsande, sedited), resolved by rationale with no objection (ajtowns)
Existing ACKs are stale relative to the latest fix (achow101, jeanpablojp)
Overall sentiment is positive with substantive review and a confirmed fix

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it closes a real enforcement gap that left non-conforming peers connected instead of disconnected
Confirmed and extended by a reviewer's testing to cover counts above MAX_SIZE
Practical harm is moderate rather than severe since it only concerns a lingering non-conforming connection

why: P3 because it fixes a real correctness gap in a widely-used serialization primitive shared by other LIMITED_VECTOR callers
The fix is narrow in scope but improves the underlying primitive's correctness on 32-bit systems too
